notablePrerequisites: Ezzaroot Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Ezzaroot Channeler to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning itself to your hand, untapping Ezzaroot Channeler.
Pay 2 life to cast Wirewood Symbiote.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve Wirewood Symbiote.
Repeat.
